item.title: Design file specifications for custom lapel pins
item.description: The artwork rules that decide whether a design can be produced: 0.3 mm minimum line width, minimum colour block size, minimum text height by pin diameter, accepted file formats, and what cannot be enamel filled.

item.title: Five lapel pin processes compared
item.description: Hard enamel, soft enamel, die struck, 3D die cast and offset printed pins judged on the same criteria: base metal, relief depth, minimum line width, colour count, durability, tooling and lead time.

item.title: What Actually Determines the Price of a Custom Lapel Pin
item.description: Nine variables move a custom lapel pin quotation, and only four of them are still yours to change once the design is drawn.

item.title: FOB, CIF or DDP: Which Trade Term to Put on Your Pin Order
item.description: The three terms decide who pays for freight, who carries the risk in transit and whether duty is already in the price.

item.title: How to Order Custom Lapel Pins from China: A Step-by-Step Sourcing Guide
item.description: What actually happens between your enquiry and the cartons arriving: CAD proofing, tooling, sampling, production scheduling, packing and the shipping terms that decide your landed cost.

item.title: Hard Enamel vs Soft Enamel Pins: Which Finish Should You Specify?
item.description: Both fills use the same metal and the same plating. The difference is how the enamel sits on the surface, and that single fact changes the colour depth, the durability and what your artwork can carry.

item.title: How to order custom lapel pins in bulk from China
item.description: The complete procurement guide: what quantity changes about the schedule, how tooling and sampling work, which packaging options exist, and which trade terms you are actually choosing between.

item.title: Lapel Pin Sizes: A Practical Guide to Choosing the Right Diameter
item.description: From 0.5 inch to 2.5 inch, here is how diameter changes the look of a pin, how much detail survives the process, and which sizes work for logos, mascots and full artwork.

item.title: Custom Challenge Coin Sizes: Diameter and Thickness Compared
item.description: The four diameters we produce most, how thickness changes the weight and the price of the material, and which combination suits a corporate recognition coin versus a competition piece.

item.title: Frequently asked questions about custom lapel pins
item.description: Twenty-seven questions buyers ask every week: tooling charges, sample cost, Pantone matching, colour limits, plating, inspection, DDP shipping and what happens to a defective batch.

item.title: Wholesale custom enamel pins: five production processes
item.description: Hard enamel, soft enamel, die struck, 3D die cast and offset printed lapel pins with the technical specification for each process, produced in our own 8,000 sqm factory.

item.title: Challenge coins, medals, keychains, cufflinks and belt buckles
item.description: Wholesale metal swag for corporate recognition, conferences and events, produced in larger sizes and thicker stock than a lapel pin requires.

item.title: Custom metal badges
item.description: All-metal badges with no enamel and nothing to chip, where the visual interest comes from relief depth, edge treatment and the contrast between polished and sandblasted surfaces.

item.title: Samples and prototyping
item.description: A physical sample before a bulk run, and a clear statement of what a sample can and cannot prove about colour, finish and durability.

item.title: Lapel pin materials: brass, iron, steel and zinc alloy
item.description: Five base metals for custom lapel pins, with the thickness each one carries, the minimum line width it allows, and the processes each one opens up.

item.title: Plating finishes for custom lapel pins: 12 options
item.description: Twelve plating finishes for custom lapel pins, from shiny 24K gold to matte ruthenium, and how each one is applied and tested on every batch.

item.title: Lapel pin backings: clutch, safety pin, screw back, magnet
item.description: Five pin backings for custom lapel pins: the standard butterfly clutch with a rubber cap, safety pins, screw backs, magnets and double clutches.

item.title: Our factory and quality control
item.description: 22 CNC centres, 16 hydraulic presses, 8 zinc alloy die casters, 24 enamel dispensing robots and 18 hand-colouring technicians in six workshops on an 8,000 sqm floor in Kunshan, Jiangsu.
